title: Nintendo Switch 2 Black Friday deals 2026 UK: console and bundle prices
seoTitle: Switch 2 Black Friday Deals 2026 UK: Prices to Wait For
description: Nintendo Switch 2 Black Friday 2026: today's UK console and bundle prices, the £354.99 low to aim for, and which bundle is the best value.
intro:
**Short answer: the Switch 2 console is £389.99 at Smyths today, but it was £354.99 during Amazon's Prime sale in early October, so wait for Black Friday unless it's needed sooner.** If you'd like a case too, Smyths sells the console with a PowerA Slim Case for £399.99, just £10 more.

Nintendo raised the official price to £419.99 on 1 September, and John Lewis is back at that full price. The new Mario Kart World bundle went on sale on 29 October and is £449.99 at Smyths. Currys has started its Black Friday sale early and will refund the difference if something you buy before 24 November gets cheaper there before 1 December. Prices were last checked on 30 October 2026.

deals.note: Out since 29 October. £10 under John Lewis (£459.99). The game is a download code, not a cartridge, and you get 3 months of Switch Online. Last year's bundle fell to about £405 on Black Friday.

deals.note: Full price at both John Lewis and Smyths. A good family pick, but it only launched last week and new bundles rarely get big cuts this early.

body:
## Switch 2 prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are the lowest UK prices we've seen. At or near these, it's a genuinely good deal.

- **Switch 2 console (RRP £419.99):** £354.99 at Amazon during Prime Big Deal Days, 6–7 October 2026, matched by Argos, John Lewis and Smyths. Which? puts the six-month average at about £420. Anything under £370 is good.
- **Mario Kart World bundle (2026 edition, RRP £459.99):** the old version was about £415 at Amazon in October. Aim for £420 or less.
- **Black Friday 2025, for reference:** the original Mario Kart World bundle (RRP £429.99, with a physical game) fell to £404.95 at Amazon and £409 at Currys, John Lewis and Very.

## Which Switch 2 should you buy?

**Console only:** best if you already know which games you want, or want to buy games second-hand.

**A bundle with a game you'd buy anyway:** usually the cheapest way in, but not right now. We couldn't confirm a current price for the older Animal Crossing and Pokémon Legends: Z-A bundles this week, and today the console at £389.99 plus a boxed copy of Mario Kart World at £59.99 costs the same as the new bundle.

**The 2026 Mario Kart World and Sports Resort bundles:** fine for Christmas, but note the game is a digital code linked to your Nintendo account, not a cartridge you can lend or sell. They also include 90 days of Nintendo Switch Online. Both are £449.99 at Smyths today.

**Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition:** a special-design console with no game, £429.99 at Smyths and £434.95 at John Lewis, where it's sold out until 5 November. Only for collectors.

## Will the Switch 2 be cheaper on Black Friday 2026?

Probably a little. Retailers have already shown they'll sell the console for £354.99, and Black Friday prices usually match or beat Prime sale prices. But the price rise in September came from rising memory costs, and stock of the cheapest bundles is thinning, so a drop well below £355 seems unlikely. Our steer: if you see the console at about £355, or a game bundle under £400, buy it.

### Is it worth buying a Switch 2 now or waiting?

Wait if you can. It's £389.99 today, and it was £354.99 at the start of October. If you need to buy before Black Friday, Currys' price guarantee means you'd get the difference back if its own price falls before 1 December, though Currys has to be selling it at a competitive price for that to help.

### Which Switch 2 bundle is the best value?

Right now, none of the game bundles saves much. The Mario Kart World bundle is £449.99 at Smyths, the same as the console plus a boxed copy of the game bought separately, and the Sports Resort bundle is the same price. The console with a PowerA case at £399.99 is the best small extra.

### Does the Mario Kart World bundle come with a physical game?

Not the 2026 version. It comes with a download code. Last year's bundle had a cartridge; if you see one of those still on sale, check the listing carefully.

### Where is cheapest for the Switch 2 in the UK?

It changes week to week. Today Smyths is £389.99 for the console, while John Lewis is at the full £419.99. Amazon, Argos, John Lewis and Smyths all matched the £354.99 low in October, so check them all on Black Friday. Currys' Black Friday sale is already running, so keep an eye on it too.

See also our [Black Friday 2026 guides](/black-friday/), including [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), and [what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/).
